goal.objective: Exact compatible reproducible Core/Smart delivery carrying Composition Recipe 1.0.1 and typed table row/context/bulk action intent

requirements.criterion: Deliver the exact compatible Core/Smart pair from committed source and native builder inputs; independently repeated builds produce identical runtime bytes.
Ship Composition Recipe 1.0.1 with all ten normative lock paths present and checksum-valid; emitted ESM imports and inherited owner-bound content compilation work.
Bind registry, BOM, resource origin/checksum index and runtime archive hashes to that same pair; no moving reference substitutes for an immutable revision.
Preserve shared JavaScript/PHP canonicalization and positive/negative Recipe checks, with PHP fixture checks distinguished from a complete PHP resolver.

Implement the accepted typed row/context/bulk action port: complete string/safe-integer IDs, closed immutable payload, owning-instance routing, exactly-once activation, keyboard/nested controls and disconnect/remount cleanup. Framework emits intent; product operations and ACL remain Larena-owned.

Confirm bounded regression and archived-pair browser scenarios: login/password form participation, structured/nested cells, search/filter/query, dropdown/modal/forms, wide/narrow widths, dark RTL, restart and console.

Obtain exact-pair Larena consumer acceptance in the separately authorized isolated copies, preserving original dirty copies, main, current pins, databases and running sites; never substitute supply readback for actual product hydration/action acceptance.

Verify coherent rollback and failed-publication preservation at the claimed release scope, pass applicable coordinated owner gates, and deliver Larena handoff with exact revisions, archives, provenance, commands, limitations and rollback. A local rehearsal is not a production publication transaction.

ownership.ui-source: Normative Recipe schemas, algorithm, fixtures, public table action port and first-party source runtime
ownership.ui-builder: Native reproducible packaging and generated contract binding
ownership.ui: Generated Core runtime and immutable exact-pair contract selection
ownership.ui-control: Assignments, compatibility state, bounded acceptance and immutable supply handoff
ownership.larena: Product operations, data, permissions, concurrency and independent consumer acceptance

invariants: Recipe is assembly input; Document is the complete validated tree; HTML is renderer output
No grammar fork, new component hierarchy, competing renderer or product storage format
Framework emits action intent; it does not execute product operations
No hand edits to generated runtime distributions
No new runtime dependency or package ownership transfer
Preserve original dirty worktrees and unfinished ui-loader
Larena original copies, main/current pins, databases and running sites are protected; independent explicitly approved isolated acceptance copies only

public_action_contract.record_ids: Nonempty array of complete opaque nonempty strings or safe integers; integer 0 and string 0 remain distinct
public_action_contract.payload: Closed immutable copied detail and ID array
public_action_contract.routing: Owning table instance, nested and sibling isolation, registered product handler
public_action_contract.activation: Exactly once for supported pointer/keyboard/context/bulk paths
public_action_contract.cleanup: Disconnect/remount clears selection and owned activation handlers; declared configuration remains
public_action_contract.excluded: Create without an existing ID; endpoint, permissions, callbacks and product business execution are outside payload

acceptance_boundary: This review has no owner acceptance receipt. Code, tests, a live Goal or generic continuation cannot manufacture architecture acceptance. Native target export/connect and publication require the exact accepted contract and separate real consumer/release evidence.

existing_architecture_reference.use: Historical ownership/compatibility background only; its different execution goal is not reused as current acceptance
